summary.text: Rollan Roberts is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 9 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A pastor, he has worked as senior pastor of Victory Baptist Church and administrator of Victory Baptist Academy.

paragraphs.text: Rollan Roberts lives in Beaver, West Virginia, and earned a B.A. in biblical languages from Pensacola Christian College in 1988.
His career experience includes working as senior pastor of Victory Baptist Church and as administrator of Victory Baptist Academy.
Roberts took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2018, succeeding Lynne Arvon.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Workforce Committee, is vice chair of the Finance Committee, and also serves on the Education, Enrolled Bills, and Health and Human Resources committees.
